pipeline: story tree -> opening shots -> videoPrompt; see video/docs/chapter-videos.md
style: high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified), xuan paper #eceae4 ground, flat grey layers #d2d1cc #a8a8a4 #6e6e6c, ink black #141414 and charcoal #3a3a3a silhouettes with angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white, faceless figures, large empty paper, side view, 16:9; vermilion #b3241c as the only accent, under 10% of the frame
negative: other colours, gold, Japanese katana, dense fine cun texture strokes, CG gradients, photorealism, 3D render, anime faces, any text, calligraphy, seals, watermark, weapons touching bodies, fighting contact, gore
motionRule: richer but controlled motion (wind, mist, ink spread, flowing water, banners, slow camera); keep silhouettes consistent, no morphing, no new figures, no text, no fighting contact; only black, grey, paper white and vermilion
lengthRule: shots = clamp(4 + ceil(scenes/2), 6, 16) = clamp(4 + ceil(26/2), 6, 16) = 16; 8 s each
grade: palette lock (video/tools/chapter_grade.py): every pixel goes to the ink #141414 -> paper #eceae4 grey ramp by luminance, except hues near vermilion #b3241c (re-tinted to vermilion); saturated orange is pulled to vermilion, pale orange, yellow, blue and every other hue go to grey

audio.music: original procedural bed (numpy): low D drone, sparse plucked D-major-pentatonic notes (guqin-like), deep drum on the title card
audio.loudness: -16 LUFS integrated, -1.5 dBTP; AAC 160k stereo; music and ambience duck about 8 dB under narration
